params.body:
The sources of Gentells' own reports, held in Gentells, so that a reader who follows one can later land on what Gentells holds for it. Posts cite their sources under a sentence (`article_evidence`). A report has only its file, so its sources are held by their number in its source list.

## What is added

- **`report_sources`** (`packages/core/report-citations.mjs`): one row per source, with the report, its number in the list, the signal that holds the page, publisher, title, date, and the address as the report printed it. `sourcesOfReport(slug)` reads them, and the report source check (`reportSources`, Studio Reports) now returns them as `held`.
- **`bin/cite-report-sources.mjs <plan.json> --by=<person> [--dry]`**, with `--undo=<run>`:
  - One signal per page, under "Cited by the author". A page the Observatory holds is reused by its address, and the same page listed twice is one signal.
  - A new page is read once (title, publisher, date, opening text). A TikTok, Instagram or YouTube post is held without a read. A page that refuses the read is held with the title from the plan and marked unread, so it can still be linked.
  - Pages are read before the write, and everything is written in one transaction.
  - New publishers go to the review queue on the Sources page, proposed and inactive, as for posts. A source read for inspiration only is skipped.
  - `--dry` reads and writes nothing. The undo takes the run's rows off and deletes the signals it created, unless a post or another report cites them by then.
- **Fix to #447:** platform posts are only the apps' own hosts. `newsroom.tiktok.com` matched as a TikTok post and would have been held unread, although it is an ordinary news page (R2 cites it six times).

## The plan (sent separately, `plan-2026-11-12.json`)

63 sources over R1, R2, R8, R9 and R10. 30 of them printed only a home page or a broken address, so the actual page was looked up and checked first. Two are left out until the report's author says which page is meant (R8 #4 European Parliament, R8 #15 TikTok). R5 The New East has no text layer and is not in this plan.

Rehearsed on a scratch database with the live pages: 63 held, 10 held unread (pages that refuse automated reads: Reuters, Ofcom, McKinsey, Klarna investors, Peerspace, education.gouv.fr, ChefMaison, Erloom). The undo left nothing behind.

## On the box, after merge

```
node bin/cite-report-sources.mjs ~/report-sources-plan-2026-11-12.json --by='Shane Deconinck' --dry
node bin/cite-report-sources.mjs ~/report-sources-plan-2026-11-12.json --by='Shane Deconinck'
# undo: node bin/cite-report-sources.mjs --undo=report-sources-2026-11-12
```

## Tests

- `test/cite-report-sources.test.mjs` (4): a plan with holes refused; the dry run writes nothing; held, read, reused, unread and platform pages; the same page twice gives one signal; publishers queued; inspiration skipped; a second run holds nothing twice; the undo deletes only what it made.
- `test/source-by-link.test.mjs`: the newsroom and about pages are not platform posts.
- Full suite 1657/1657, `tsc` clean.
params.title: Report sources held in Gentells (cite-report-sources)
